_why: NIGHT65 builder S round 2 (card Research/2026-10-23-wave65/cards/a4.md; the lead's round-2 list: a climb route up, no safe firing post, the parry the answer): THE SPITTING GALLERY. The spitters hold the north end of THE GALLERY, a 3.0 m deck down the west wall reached only by its stair, whose whole run lies 7.5-13.5 m from them (inside spitter.maxRange 24, outside minRange 6: they lob at anyone on it). THE PARAPET on the gallery's north 6 m blinds every floor spot within 6 m of them, so the only place inside their minRange is the gallery's own north end, reached by crossing 10 m of open stair and deck under their lobs. Every piece carries its job and why.
